items.claim: Manuel Sousa is a nasty striker with incredible power who sets a relentless pace.
items.quote: Manuel Sousa, nasty striker. He's got incredible power. He sets a relentless pace.

items.claim: Manuel Sousa has a knockout win over Mauricio Ruffi.
items.quote: He has 15 fights in his career. He even has a knockout win over Mauricio Ruffi.

items.claim: Manuel Sousa's fight IQ is not the best and he is continuing to learn.
items.quote: But the fight IQ is not the best, and he is continuing to learn.

items.claim: Balaji Aoki was able to take down Manuel Sousa in their fight.
items.quote: Balaji Aoki, who is a striker, was able to take down Manuel Sousa in that fight.

items.claim: Manuel Sousa's sole MMA loss showed that takedown defense is what failed him.
items.quote: his sole MMA loss go to that one in the 14 and one and you saw the takedown defense is what failed him in that fight.

items.claim: Richie Miranda is a heavy-handed grappler who advances positions and finds submissions in transitions.
items.quote: Richie Miranda, a heavy-handed grappler... On the ground, he does an unbelievable job of advancing positions, striking, and finding those submissions in the transitions.

items.claim: Richie Miranda can be very hittable on the feet.
items.quote: I do hate how hittable Richie can be.

items.claim: Miles Johns is a strong, high-level wrestler with heavy hands and explosive speed who wrestled long before his MMA career.
items.quote: He's a strong wrestler. He's got heavy hands, explosive speed, high-level wrestler. He wrestled in real life long before his MMA career

items.claim: Miles Johns's cardio can be questioned, though he goes hard for at least 1.5 rounds.
items.quote: His cardio can be questioned, but for at least 1 and 1/2 rounds, that guy gets after and he gets after it hard.

items.claim: Miles Johns is coming off a submission loss to Daniel Marcos.
items.quote: He is coming off the submission loss to Daniel Marcos
